blocks.text: Markets for Global Specialty Metal Supply

T.I. has been providing the world with specialty metals and titanium products since 1972. We maintain a complete inventory of specialty metals and titanium mill products, offering a wide variety of grades and sizes with lead times to satisfy your manufacturing needs. T.I. is the global leader in specialty metals supply for the aerospace, defense, medical, industrial, oil & gas markets. Explore Titanium Industries’ Global Specialty Metal Supply:
